description:
Find verified free open-source replacements for a paid AI product.

    Backed by the Swap Map at thedailyworkflow.com/alternatives — every
    replacement is checked by hand against live GitHub (stars, license,
    last push). Answer honestly from the returned status:
      - "covered": list the replacements (repo, stars, license,
        coverage full/partial, why_en, setup_level) and the money saved.
      - "checked_no_replacement": the product was audited and no
        verified free replacement exists yet — say exactly that.
      - "unknown": not audited yet; may include up to 3 covered
        "suggestions" nearby — present them as neighbours, NOT as
        replacements for this product.

    Args:
        product_name: Paid product name, e.g. "Midjourney", "Notion AI",
                      "Jasper". Case-insensitive.

product_name.description: Name of the paid product to find verified free open-source replacements for, e.g. "Midjourney", "Notion AI" or "Jasper". Case-insensitive.
product_name.title: Product Name

name: find_free_alternative
